#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class InputReader {
public:
    std::istream& in;
    std::string buffer;
    std::istringstream iss;

    InputReader(std::istream& inStream) : in(inStream) {}

    std::string next() {
        while (!(iss >> buffer)) {
            std::getline(in, buffer);
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(buffer);
        }
        return buffer;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return std::stoi(next());
    }
};

class MinCostMaxFlow {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int u, flow, rev, cost;
        Edge(int u, int flow, int cost, int rev) : u(u), flow(flow), cost(cost), rev(rev) {}
    };

    std::vector<std::vector<Edge>> graph;
    std::vector<std::vector<Edge>> edgesArr;
    std::vector<int> dist;
    int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
    const int INF = INT_MAX / 100;

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int s, int t) : N(n), S(s), T(t), maxFlow(0), minCost(0) {
        graph.resize(N);
        dist.resize(N);
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        int lu = (int)graph[u].size();
        int lv = (int)graph[v].size();
        graph[u].emplace_back(v, flow, cost, lv);
        graph[v].emplace_back(u, 0, -cost, lu);
    }

    void convertToArray() {
        edgesArr.resize(N);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            edgesArr[i] = graph[i];
            graph[i].clear();
        }
    }

    bool bellmanFordCheck() {
        std::fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
        dist[S] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                for (auto& e : edgesArr[j]) {
                    if (e.flow > 0 && dist[j] + e.cost < dist[e.u]) {
                        dist[e.u] = dist[j] + e.cost;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            for (auto& e : edgesArr[j]) {
                if (e.flow > 0 && dist[j] + e.cost < dist[e.u]) return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    std::vector<int> parent, parentEdge;
    std::vector<int> node;
    std::vector<int> visit;
    std::vector<int> prev, prevEdge;
    std::vector<int> distance;

    bool spfa() {
        node.resize(N);
        visit.resize(N);
        parent.resize(N);
        parentEdge.resize(N);
        distance.resize(N);
        std::fill(distance.begin(), distance.end(), INF);
        std::queue<int> q;
        distance[S] = 0;
        q.push(S);
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            visit[u] = 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)edgesArr[u].size(); i++) {
                auto& e = edgesArr[u][i];
                if (e.flow > 0 && distance[u] + e.cost < distance[e.u]) {
                    distance[e.u] = distance[u] + e.cost;
                    parent[e.u] = u;
                    parentEdge[e.u] = i;
                    if (visit[e.u] == 0) {
                        q.push(e.u);
                        visit[e.u] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return visit[T] != 0;
    }

    bool dijkstra() {
        std::fill(distance.begin(), distance.end(), INF);
        parent.assign(N, -1);
        parentEdge.assign(N, -1);
        std::priority_queue<std::pair<int,int>, std::vector<std::pair<int,int>>, std::greater<>> pq;
        distance[S] = 0;
        pq.emplace(0, S);
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [dist_u, u] = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            if (dist_u > distance[u]) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)edgesArr[u].size(); i++) {
                auto& e = edgesArr[u][i];
                if (e.flow > 0 && distance[u] + e.cost < distance[e.u]) {
                    distance[e.u] = distance[u] + e.cost;
                    parent[e.u] = u;
                    parentEdge[e.u] = i;
                    pq.emplace(distance[e.u], e.u);
                }
            }
        }
        return parent[T] != -1;
    }

    int augment() {
        int flow = INT_MAX;
        for (int p = T; p != S; p = parent[p]) {
            int u = parent[p], i = parentEdge[p];
            flow = std::min(flow, edgesArr[u][i].flow);
        }
        for (int p = T; p != S; p = parent[p]) {
            int u = parent[p], i = parentEdge[p];
            edgesArr[u][i].flow -= flow;
            int rev = edgesArr[u][i].rev;
            edgesArr[p][rev].flow += flow;
        }
        maxFlow += flow;
        return flow;
    }

    bool minCostFlow() {
        while (bellmanFordCheck()) {
            minCost += dist[T] * augment();
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    InputReader in(cin);
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int m = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    int c = in.nextInt();
    int d = in.nextInt();

    int maxl = n + k;
    int T = n * maxl + 1;
    MinCostMaxFlow flow(T + 1, 0, T);
    std::vector<int> a(k + 1, 0);
    std::vector<int> f(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
        a[i] = in.nextInt();
        f[a[i]]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (f[i] == 0) continue;
        flow.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            flow.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
        int a_ = in.nextInt(), b_ = in.nextInt();
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; l++) {
            for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                if (a_ != 1)
                    flow.addEdge(n * l + a_, n * (l + 1) + b_, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                if (b_ != 1)
                    flow.addEdge(n * l + b_, n * (l + 1) + a_, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int l = 1; l < maxl; l++) {
        flow.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
    }
    flow.convertToArray();
    flow.minCostFlow();
    if (flow.maxFlow != k) {
        std::cout << "BUG\n";
    } else {
        std::cout << flow.minCost << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
